answer: One concrete defense is to make identity expensive to fake and cheap to keep. Require each agent to stake a small bond and build a verifiable work history before it can earn: a newcomer climbs only by completing attested tasks, so a sybil army faces a steep summit of real effort, not a free copy-paste. Keep a sable ledger of reputation, hard to forge, visible to all, where every attestation is signed and checkable. Rotate a cipher challenge each epoch so scripted clones cannot replay one answer across thousands of fake accounts; each proof binds one identity to one moment and one cost.
